name: patchai
description: Finds security vulnerabilities in Python code and fixes them with the PatchAI model, with checks and human approval.

viewsWelcome.contents:
PatchAI finds security holes in Python code and fixes them with a locally running, fine-tuned model. Every fix is proven by tests, a real attack and a re-scan before you apply it.
[Scan Workspace](command:patchai.scan)
[Open Demo Project](command:patchai.openDemo)
[Check Setup](command:patchai.checkSetup)

walkthroughs.title: Get started with PatchAI
walkthroughs.description: Scan, fix and review your first vulnerability in about five minutes.

steps.title: Check the setup
steps.description:
PatchAI needs its local server, Ollama and the scanners.
[Check Setup](command:patchai.checkSetup)

steps.title: Open the demo project
steps.description:
A small, deliberately vulnerable online shop, on a safe copy.
[Open Demo Project](command:patchai.openDemo)

steps.title: Scan and read a finding
steps.description:
Findings show up as underlines, in the Problems panel and in the PatchAI side bar.
[Scan Workspace](command:patchai.scan)

steps.title: Fix it and review the evidence
steps.description:
One click runs the whole pipeline. Accept only what you have seen proven.
[Fix with AI](command:patchai.fix)

patchai.serverUrl.description: Base URL of the local PatchAI server.

patchai.model.description: Model used to write fixes. Leave empty to use the server's default model. Use 'PatchAI: Select Model' to pick one.

patchai.pythonPath.description: Python interpreter used to start the PatchAI server. Leave empty to use the PatchAI folder's .venv (or plain 'python' if there is none). A relative path (for example .venv/Scripts/python.exe) is resolved against the PatchAI folder.

patchai.serverDir.description: The PatchAI folder (the repository root with config.yaml). Leave empty to find it automatically.

patchai.scanOnSave.description: Scan the workspace again after a Python file is saved (quietly: no popups).

patchai.scanOnOpen.description: Scan the workspace when a folder with Python files is opened.

patchai.autoStartServer.description: Start the PatchAI server automatically when it is not running.
